title: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne
notes: Map achievements unlock the moment a map finishes loading, including when you load a save.
Chapter achievements come from your save games: save once in each new chapter and the chapter before it counts, even if Vault was closed while you played.
Build checked: Steam maxpayne2.exe (v1.01, DLLs dated 17 Oct 2003).

testGuide.title: Start Max Payne 2 from Vault
testGuide.detail: Click Play on the game page, or start it from Steam.

testGuide.title: Start a new game or load a save
testGuide.detail: The map fingerprint should change from 0 to a number once the map has loaded.
